topics.name: Idioms & Proverbs: Animals
topics.description: Elephants, tigers, crocodiles, dogs and fish: sayings with an animal in them. English gives the meaning; the note gives the literal image.

cards.thai: ปลาใหญ่กินปลาเล็ก
cards.english: the strong prey on the weak
cards.note: Lit. "big fish eat small fish".

cards.thai: เสือนอนกิน
cards.english: to profit without lifting a finger
cards.note: Lit. "a tiger that eats lying down".

cards.thai: ฆ่าช้างเอางา
cards.english: to destroy something great for a small gain
cards.note: Lit. "kill an elephant for its tusks".

cards.thai: ช้างตายทั้งตัวเอาใบบัวปิด
cards.english: to try to hide what can't be hidden
cards.note: Lit. "cover a whole dead elephant with a lotus leaf".

cards.thai: แมวไม่อยู่ หนูร่าเริง
cards.english: when the cat's away, the mice will play
cards.note: Lit. "the cat's not in, the mice are merry".

cards.thai: กระต่ายตื่นตูม
cards.english: to panic over nothing
cards.note: Lit. "a hare startled by a thud": in the Jataka tale, a bael fruit falls on a palm leaf and the hare runs off crying that the earth is caving in.

cards.thai: วัวลืมตีน
cards.english: to forget where you came from (once doing well)
cards.note: Lit. "a cow forgetting its feet".

cards.thai: หมากัดอย่ากัดตอบ
cards.english: don't stoop to their level
cards.note: Lit. "if a dog bites you, don't bite it back".

cards.thai: จระเข้ขวางคลอง
cards.english: someone who stands in everyone's way
cards.note: Lit. "a crocodile lying across the canal".

cards.thai: ลิงหลอกเจ้า
cards.english: to be polite to someone's face and mock them behind their back
cards.note: Lit. "a monkey teasing its master".

cards.thai: กิ้งก่าได้ทอง
cards.english: to get above yourself after a little luck
cards.note: Lit. "a lizard given gold": in the tale it puffed itself up and stopped bowing to the king.

cards.thai: หมาหวงก้าง
cards.english: a dog in the manger
cards.note: Lit. "a dog guarding a fish bone": it can't eat it, but won't let anyone else.

cards.thai: คางคกขึ้นวอ
cards.english: an upstart who forgets himself
cards.note: Lit. "a toad carried in a palanquin".

cards.thai: ปลาข้องเดียวกัน
cards.english: all of the same lot / birds of a feather
cards.note: Lit. "fish from the same creel".

cards.thai: ม้าตีนต้น
cards.english: someone who starts fast and soon runs out of steam
cards.note: Lit. "a horse quick off the mark".

cards.thai: ชี้โพรงให้กระรอก
cards.english: to put ideas in a troublemaker's head
cards.note: Lit. "point out the hollow to the squirrel".

cards.thai: สอนจระเข้ให้ว่ายน้ำ
cards.english: to teach an expert what they already know
cards.note: Lit. "teach a crocodile to swim".

cards.thai: ตาบอดคลำช้าง
cards.english: to judge the whole from one small part
cards.note: Lit. "the blind feeling an elephant".

cards.thai: ดูช้างให้ดูหาง ดูนางให้ดูแม่
cards.english: to know a girl, look at her mother
cards.note: Lit. "to judge an elephant, look at its tail; to judge a girl, look at her mother".

cards.thai: ขว้างงูไม่พ้นคอ
cards.english: trouble you throw off lands back on you
cards.note: Lit. "throw a snake and it ends up round your own neck".

cards.thai: ยิงปืนนัดเดียวได้นกสองตัว
cards.english: to kill two birds with one stone
cards.note: Lit. "fire the gun once and get two birds".

cards.thai: น้ำมาปลากินมด น้ำลดมดกินปลา
cards.english: the tables always turn
cards.note: Lit. "when the water rises fish eat ants; when it falls ants eat fish".

cards.thai: ตีปลาหน้าไซ
cards.english: to spoil something that's going well for someone
cards.note: Lit. "beat the fish away at the mouth of the trap".

cards.thai: ม้าดีดกะโหลก
cards.english: gawky and unladylike (said of a woman)
cards.note: Lit. "a horse kicking a coconut shell".

cards.thai: ไก่แก่แม่ปลาช่อน
cards.english: a wily, brazen older woman
cards.note: Lit. "an old hen, a mother snakehead fish".

topics.name: Idioms & Proverbs: Caution, Effort & Money
topics.description: Look before you leap, keep at it, live within your means. English gives the meaning; the note gives the literal image.

cards.thai: กันไว้ดีกว่าแก้
cards.english: better safe than sorry / prevention is better than cure
cards.note: Lit. "guarding beats fixing". The nearest to "measure twice, cut once".

cards.thai: อย่าไว้ใจทาง อย่าวางใจคน
cards.english: don't take anything on trust
cards.note: Lit. "don't trust the road, don't rely on people".

cards.thai: นกน้อยทำรังแต่พอตัว
cards.english: to live within your means
cards.note: Lit. "a little bird builds a nest just its size".

cards.thai: ได้คืบจะเอาศอก
cards.english: give them an inch and they'll take a mile
cards.note: Lit. "given a hand's span, they want a forearm".

cards.thai: เข็นครกขึ้นภูเขา
cards.english: an uphill task
cards.note: Lit. "push a stone mortar up a mountain".

cards.thai: ฝนทั่งให้เป็นเข็ม
cards.english: keep at it and you'll get there
cards.note: Lit. "grind an anvil down to a needle".

cards.thai: ไฟไหม้ฟาง
cards.english: keen at first, then it fizzles out
cards.note: Lit. "fire in straw": a big blaze, soon out.

cards.thai: ตำข้าวสารกรอกหม้อ
cards.english: to live hand to mouth
cards.note: Lit. "pound just enough rice to fill the pot".

cards.thai: หาเช้ากินค่ำ
cards.english: to live day to day, earning just enough
cards.note: Lit. "earn in the morning, eat in the evening".

cards.thai: ทำนาบนหลังคน
cards.english: to get rich off other people's backs
cards.note: Lit. "farm rice on people's backs".

cards.thai: ผีซ้ำด้ำพลอย
cards.english: when it rains, it pours
cards.note: Lit. "the ghosts pile on and even the house spirit joins in".

cards.thai: ไม้ซีกงัดไม้ซุง
cards.english: the small can't take on the mighty
cards.note: Lit. "a sliver of wood trying to lever up a log".

cards.thai: น้ำเชี่ยวอย่าขวางเรือ
cards.english: don't cross the powerful (or someone in a temper)
cards.note: Lit. "in a swift current, don't turn your boat across it".

cards.thai: ใกล้เกลือกินด่าง
cards.english: to overlook what's good right next to you
cards.note: Lit. "near the salt, but eating lye".

cards.thai: รู้ไว้ใช่ว่า ใส่บ่าแบกหาม
cards.english: knowing more is never a burden
cards.note: Lit. "what you know isn't a load you carry on your shoulder".

cards.thai: ความรู้ท่วมหัว เอาตัวไม่รอด
cards.english: book-smart but no use when it counts
cards.note: Lit. "knowledge over your head, yet you can't save yourself".

cards.thai: อาบน้ำร้อนมาก่อน
cards.english: I've been around longer than you
cards.note: Lit. "I bathed in hot water before you": said by an elder whose advice comes from experience.

cards.thai: ไม้อ่อนดัดง่าย ไม้แก่ดัดยาก
cards.english: teach them while they're young
cards.note: Lit. "young wood bends easily, old wood hardly".

cards.thai: เกาไม่ถูกที่คัน
cards.english: to miss the real problem
cards.note: Lit. "scratch where it doesn't itch".

cards.thai: น้ำลดตอผุด
cards.english: when power goes, past misdeeds come to light
cards.note: Lit. "when the water drops, the stumps appear".

cards.thai: หนีร้อนมาพึ่งเย็น
cards.english: to come seeking refuge
cards.note: Lit. "flee the heat to shelter in the cool".

cards.thai: ตัดไฟแต่ต้นลม
cards.english: to nip it in the bud
cards.note: Lit. "cut off the fire where the wind starts".

cards.thai: ได้อย่างเสียอย่าง
cards.english: you can't have it all
cards.note: Lit. "gain one thing, lose another".

topics.name: Idioms & Proverbs: Talk & Character
topics.description: Blabbermouths, fence-sitters, stubborn pairs and choosing your friends. English gives the meaning; the note gives the literal image.

cards.thai: ฆ้องปากแตก
cards.english: a blabbermouth who can't keep a secret
cards.note: Lit. "a gong with a cracked rim".

cards.thai: พูดไปสองไพเบี้ย นิ่งเสียตำลึงทอง
cards.english: speech is silver, silence is golden
cards.note: Lit. "speak and it's worth two pai in cowries; keep quiet and it's a tael of gold".

cards.thai: ไปไหนมาสามวาสองศอก
cards.english: an answer that has nothing to do with the question
cards.note: Lit. "where have you been? — three wa and two cubits".

cards.thai: น้ำกลิ้งบนใบบอน
cards.english: fickle, never committing to anything
cards.note: Lit. "water rolling on a taro leaf".

cards.thai: ทองไม่รู้ร้อน
cards.english: unmoved, couldn't care less
cards.note: Lit. "gold that doesn't feel the heat".

cards.thai: หน้าเนื้อใจเสือ
cards.english: a wolf in sheep's clothing
cards.note: Lit. "a deer's face, a tiger's heart".

cards.thai: มะกอกสามตะกร้าปาไม่ถูก
cards.english: too slippery to pin down
cards.note: Lit. "throw three baskets of hog plums and not one hits him".

cards.thai: เกลียดตัวกินไข่ เกลียดปลาไหลกินน้ำแกง
cards.english: to scorn someone but still take what they give
cards.note: Lit. "hate the hen but eat its eggs; hate the eel but drink its curry".

cards.thai: ขิงก็รา ข่าก็แรง
cards.english: neither will give an inch (both hot-headed)
cards.note: Lit. "the ginger is … and the galangal is strong": what รา meant here is no longer clear.

cards.thai: ช้างเท้าหน้า
cards.english: the one who leads (traditionally, the husband)
cards.note: Lit. "the elephant's front feet": the wife is ช้างเท้าหลัง, the back feet.

cards.thai: คนล้มอย่าข้าม
cards.english: don't kick someone when they're down
cards.note: Lit. "don't step over a fallen man".

cards.thai: ต่อความยาว สาวความยืด
cards.english: to drag a matter out
cards.note: Lit. "lengthen the matter, stretch it out".
words: ความ::a matter, an affair
สาว::to pull in, hand over hand
ความ::a matter, an affair

cards.thai: อย่าเอาไม้สั้นไปรันขี้
cards.english: don't tangle with a lowlife (you'll only get dirty)
cards.note: Lit. "don't beat dung with a short stick".

cards.thai: คบคนให้ดูหน้า ซื้อผ้าให้ดูเนื้อ
cards.english: choose your friends with care
cards.note: Lit. "look at a face before you befriend; look at the weave before you buy cloth".

cards.thai: ข้าวแดงแกงร้อน
cards.english: a debt of gratitude to someone who fed and kept you
cards.note: Lit. "red rice and hot curry".

cards.thai: ปลูกเรือนตามใจผู้อยู่ ผูกอู่ตามใจผู้นอน
cards.english: do it the way the person it's for wants
cards.note: Lit. "build the house to suit who'll live in it; hang the cradle to suit who'll sleep in it".

cards.thai: หมาหยอกไก่
cards.english: to flirt by teasing
cards.note: Lit. "a dog teasing a hen".

cards.thai: เห็นกงจักรเป็นดอกบัว
cards.english: to mistake something bad for something good
cards.note: Lit. "see a spinning blade as a lotus flower".

cards.thai: รักพี่เสียดายน้อง
cards.english: torn between two choices
cards.note: Lit. "love the elder sister, can't bear to lose the younger".

cards.thai: เข้าตามตรอก ออกตามประตู
cards.english: to do things the proper way (asking her parents first)
cards.note: Lit. "come in by the lane, leave by the gate".

cards.thai: ฝากเนื้อไว้กับเสือ
cards.english: to trust the wrong person with something
cards.note: Lit. "leave meat with a tiger".

ข้อง: fish creel (a wicker basket for the catch)
คืบ: a hand's span (thumb to little finger)
รา: (an old word in the ginger saying; its meaning is lost)
กงจักร: bladed discus (a weapon of the gods)
หาม: to carry between two people (on a pole)

word_topics.description: The words inside the sayings: gongs, cowries, taro leaves and alleys.
